title: Edit Plan — Operation Registry
description: The edit plan emitted by P1 (the agent). Every operation's `type` must be in this registry; params are flat on the object (not nested under a `params` key). P2 implements/reuses pipeline_runner handlers by `type`. Execution order: multiple remove_segment ops are run by the runner in descending start order; apply_style and add_subtitles are mutually exclusive (apply_style burns captions itself).

summary.description: One-sentence, user-facing summary (in the user's language)

unsupported.description: Requests the tools cannot do (e.g. translate subtitles, add music, replace background)

description.description: One sentence in the user's language

min_silence_duration.description: Cut only silences longer than this many seconds; default 0.35 removes almost all pauses, raise it to keep natural pauses

oneOf.$comment: No params. Handler transcribes (word-level) → LLM judges filler/false-starts/retakes → concat of kept ranges. Default first step for a zero-instruction request.

style.description: Contract ③ style-params object; if present, overrides automatic judgment

oneOf.$comment: Transcribes and burns captions itself — do not combine with add_subtitles. Chapters/data cards are produced automatically by the handler's content_planner (overridable via style).

intensity.description: Blend 0=original .. 1=full grade; handler default 0.85 to keep skin tones natural

oneOf.$comment: Whole-video color grade via OM ColorGrade (ffmpeg profile/LUT). Finishing pass -- runner applies it after cuts. Do NOT stack on apply_style (template owns the final look).

asset_ref.description: The broll asset's order index in job.assets (file is assets/broll_<asset_ref>.*)

mode.description: broll_main: b-roll fills the frame, speaker shrinks to a bottom-right inset (default). cutaway: b-roll full-frame, no speaker. pip: speaker stays full, b-roll is the small inset.

orientation.description: Output canvas. auto: landscape if the main video or any b-roll is landscape, else portrait. Set portrait/landscape only when the user explicitly asks for 竖屏/横屏.

oneOf.$comment: Overlay user-uploaded b-roll while the speaker's audio continues (single ffmpeg composite). Default mode broll_main: b-roll fills the frame, speaker becomes a bottom-right inset; talking segments show the speaker centered with pillarbox/letterbox bars. Output orientation follows the sources (auto) unless forced. Finishing pass -- runs last so timing rides the transcript timeline.
